SELECT c.range_key, c.range_label, COUNT(t1.PRODUCT_CODE) AS sku_count, '2' unit FROM rate_range_config c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.PRODUCT_CODE, CASE WHEN ifnull( PLAN_QTY, 0 ) != 0 THEN round( ifnull( finish_quantity, 0 ) / ifnull( PLAN_QTY, 0 ) * 100, 2 ) ELSE 0 END finish_rate, ifnull( finish_quantity, 0 ) finish_quantity, ifnull( PLAN_QTY, 0 ) PLAN_QTY FROM ( -- 使用 CTE 提前计算每个记录的不同日期范围的总和 WITH preprocessed_data AS ( SELECT p.PRODUCT_CODE, -- 计算 1 - 25 日的总和 CASE WHEN p.YEAR = #{year} AND p.MONTH = #{month} THEN IFNULL(p.DAY_1, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_2, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_3, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_4, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_5, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_6, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_7, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_8, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_9, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_10, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_11, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_12, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_13, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_14, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_15, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_16, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_17, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_18, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_19, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_20, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_21, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_22, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_23, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_24, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_25, 0) ELSE 0 END AS day_1_25_sum, -- 计算 26 - 31 日的总和 CASE WHEN ( (#{month} = 1 AND p.YEAR = #{year} - 1 AND p.MONTH = 12) OR (p.YEAR = #{year} AND p.MONTH = #{month} - 1) ) THEN IFNULL(p.DAY_26, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_27, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_28, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_29, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_30, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_31, 0) ELSE 0 END AS day_26_31_sum FROM
p WHERE ( (p.YEAR = #{year} AND p.MONTH IN (#{month}, #{month} - 1)) OR (#{month} = 1 AND p.YEAR = #{year} - 1 AND p.MONTH = 12) ) AND p.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND p.IS_DELETE = 0 ) -- 主查询分组汇总数据 SELECT ppd.PRODUCT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT ppd.PRODUCT_CODE) AS skuCount, SUM(ppd.day_1_25_sum + ppd.day_26_31_sum) AS PLAN_QTY FROM preprocessed_data ppd GROUP BY ppd.PRODUCT_CODE ) p LEFT JOIN ( -- 硫化完成数 SELECT f.PRODUCT_CODE, sum( f.DAY_FINISH_QTY ) finish_quantity FROM
f WHERE f.IS_DELETE = 0 AND (( -- 上个月 26 - 31 日的数据 f.FINISH_DATE BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', #{month} - 1, '-26'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND LAST_DAY(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', #{month} - 1, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d')) ) OR ( -- 本月 1 - 25 日的数据 f.FINISH_DATE BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', #{month}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', #{month}, '-25'), '%Y-%m-%d') )) GROUP BY f.PRODUCT_CODE ) f ON p.PRODUCT_CODE = f.PRODUCT_CODE ) t1 ON -- 处理特殊区间：0% (c.range_key = 0 AND t1.finish_rate = 0) OR -- 处理普通区间 (t1.finish_rate > c.min_value AND t1.finish_rate <= COALESCE(c.max_value, 999999)) OR -- 处理开区间：>160% (c.max_value IS NULL AND t1.finish_rate > c.min_value) GROUP BY c.range_label, c.range_key ORDER BY c.range_key DESC

SELECT c.range_key, c.range_label, COUNT(t1.PRODUCT_CODE) AS sku_count, '2' unit FROM rate_range_config c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.PRODUCT_CODE, CASE WHEN ifnull( PLAN_QTY, 0 ) != 0 THEN round( ifnull( finish_quantity, 0 ) / ifnull( PLAN_QTY, 0 ) * 100, 2 ) ELSE 0 END finish_rate, ifnull( finish_quantity, 0 ) finish_quantity, ifnull( PLAN_QTY, 0 ) PLAN_QTY FROM ( SELECT p.PRODUCT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT p.PRODUCT_CODE) AS skuCount, SUM( IFNULL(p.DAY_1, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_2, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_3, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_4, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_5, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_6, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_7, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_8, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_9, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_10, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_11, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_12, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_13, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_14, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_15, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_16, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_17, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_18, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_19, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_20, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_21, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_22, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_23, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_24, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_25, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_26, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_27, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_28, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_29, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_30, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_31, 0) ) as PLAN_QTY FROM
p WHERE p.YEAR = #{year} AND p.MONTH = #{month} AND p.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND p.IS_DELETE = 0 GROUP BY p.PRODUCT_CODE ) p LEFT JOIN ( -- 硫化完成数 SELECT f.PRODUCT_CODE, sum( f.DAY_FINISH_QTY ) finish_quantity FROM
f WHERE f.IS_DELETE = 0 AND (( -- 上个月 26 - 31 日的数据 f.FINISH_DATE BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', #{month} - 1, '-26'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND LAST_DAY(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', #{month} - 1, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d')) ) OR ( -- 本月 1 - 25 日的数据 f.FINISH_DATE BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', #{month}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', #{month}, '-25'), '%Y-%m-%d') )) GROUP BY f.PRODUCT_CODE ) f ON p.PRODUCT_CODE = f.PRODUCT_CODE ) t1 ON -- 处理特殊区间：0% (c.range_key = 0 AND t1.finish_rate = 0) OR -- 处理普通区间 (t1.finish_rate > c.min_value AND t1.finish_rate <= COALESCE(c.max_value, 999999)) OR -- 处理开区间：>160% (c.max_value IS NULL AND t1.finish_rate > c.min_value) GROUP BY c.range_label, c.range_key ORDER BY c.range_key DESC

SELECT c.range_key, c.range_label, COUNT(t.PRODUCT_CODE) AS sku_count, '2' unit FROM rate_range_config c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.PRODUCT_CODE, CASE WHEN ifnull( PLAN_QTY, 0 ) != 0 THEN round( ifnull( finish_quantity, 0 )/ ifnull( PLAN_QTY, 0 ) * 100, 2 ) ELSE 0 END finish_rate, ifnull( finish_quantity, 0 ) finish_quantity, ifnull( PLAN_QTY, 0 ) PLAN_QTY FROM (-- 销售订单需求计划数 SELECT p.PRODUCT_CODE, sum( p.PLAN_QTY ) PLAN_QTY FROM

SET @queryYear = #{year}; SET @queryMonth = #{month}; SET @factoryCode = #{factoryCode}; -- 使用 CTE 提前计算每个记录的不同日期范围的总和 WITH preprocessed_data AS ( SELECT p.PRODUCT_CODE, -- 计算 1 - 25 日的总和 CASE WHEN p.YEAR = @queryYear AND p.MONTH = @queryMonth THEN IFNULL(p.DAY_1, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_2, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_3, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_4, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_5, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_6, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_7, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_8, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_9, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_10, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_11, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_12, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_13, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_14, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_15, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_16, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_17, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_18, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_19, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_20, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_21, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_22, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_23, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_24, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_25, 0) ELSE 0 END AS day_1_25_sum, -- 计算 26 - 31 日的总和 CASE WHEN ( (@queryMonth = 1 AND p.YEAR = @queryYear - 1 AND p.MONTH = 12) OR (p.YEAR = @queryYear AND p.MONTH = @queryMonth - 1) ) THEN IFNULL(p.DAY_26, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_27, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_28, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_29, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_30, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_31, 0) ELSE 0 END AS day_26_31_sum FROM
p WHERE ( (p.YEAR = @queryYear AND p.MONTH IN (@queryMonth, @queryMonth - 1)) OR (@queryMonth = 1 AND p.YEAR = @queryYear - 1 AND p.MONTH = 12) ) AND p.FACTORY_CODE = @factoryCode AND p.IS_DELETE = 0 AND p.CONSTRUCTION_STAGE IN(1, 2) ) -- 主查询分组汇总数据 SELECT '试制或量试' AS rangeLabel, COUNT(DISTINCT ppd.PRODUCT_CODE) AS skuCount, SUM(ppd.day_1_25_sum + ppd.day_26_31_sum) AS PLAN_QTY FROM preprocessed_data ppd GROUP BY ppd.PRODUCT_CODE

p WHERE p.YEAR = @queryYear AND p.MONTH = @queryMonth AND p.FACTORY_CODE = @factoryCode AND p.IS_DELETE = 0 AND p.CONSTRUCTION_STAGE IN(1, 2)

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN dataType = '1' THEN QTY END) AS producePlanQty, SUM(CASE WHEN dataType = '2' THEN QTY END) AS produceFinishPlanQty, SUM(CASE WHEN dataType = '3' THEN QTY END) AS salePlanQty, SUM(CASE WHEN dataType = '4' THEN QTY END) AS saleFinishPlanQty FROM ( -- 1-25生产计划数量 SELECT SUM( IFNULL(DAY_1,0) + IFNULL(DAY_2,0) + IFNULL(DAY_3,0) + IFNULL(DAY_4,0) + IFNULL(DAY_5,0) + IFNULL(DAY_6,0) + IFNULL(DAY_7,0) + IFNULL(DAY_8,0) + IFNULL(DAY_9,0) + IFNULL(DAY_10,0) + IFNULL(DAY_11,0) + IFNULL(DAY_12,0) + IFNULL(DAY_13,0) + IFNULL(DAY_14,0) + IFNULL(DAY_15,0) + IFNULL(DAY_16,0) + IFNULL(DAY_17,0) + IFNULL(DAY_18,0) + IFNULL(DAY_19,0) + IFNULL(DAY_20,0) + IFNULL(DAY_21,0) + IFNULL(DAY_22,0) + IFNULL(DAY_23,0) + IFNULL(DAY_24,0) + IFNULL(DAY_25,0) ) QTY, '1' dataType FROM

SELECT productInfo.BRAND, stock.stockSkuCount, stock.stockQty, salePlan.skuCount as salePlanSkuCount, salePlan.PLAN_QTY as salePlanQty, saleFinish.skuCount as saleFinishSkuCount, saleFinish.finish_quantity as saleFinishPlanQty, proPlan.skuCount as produceSkuCount, proPlan.PLAN_QTY as producePlanQty, proFinish.finish_quantity as produceFinishPlanQty FROM ( SELECT BRAND FROM t_mdm_product_info WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} GROUP BY BRAND ) productInfo
LEFT JOIN ( -- 销售订单需求计划数 SELECT p.BRAND, COUNT(DISTINCT PRODUCT_CODE) skuCount, SUM( p.PLAN_QTY ) PLAN_QTY FROM
p WHERE p.YEAR = #{year} AND p.MONTH = #{month} AND p.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND p.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion} AND p.IS_DELETE = 0 GROUP BY p.BRAND ) salePlan ON salePlan.BRAND = productInfo.BRAND

f left JOIN t_mdm_product_info pro ON f.PRODUCT_CODE = pro.PRODUCT_CODE WHERE f.YEAR = #{year} AND f.MONTH = #{month} AND f.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND f.IS_DELETE = 0 GROUP BY pro.BRAND ) saleFinish ON saleFinish.BRAND = productInfo.BRAND
LEFT JOIN ( -- 使用 CTE 提前计算每个记录的不同日期范围的总和 WITH preprocessed_data AS ( SELECT p.BRAND, p.PRODUCT_CODE, -- 计算 1 - 25 日的总和 CASE WHEN p.YEAR = #{year} AND p.MONTH = #{month} THEN IFNULL(p.DAY_1, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_2, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_3, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_4, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_5, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_6, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_7, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_8, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_9, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_10, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_11, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_12, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_13, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_14, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_15, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_16, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_17, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_18, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_19, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_20, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_21, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_22, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_23, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_24, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_25, 0) ELSE 0 END AS day_1_25_sum, -- 计算 26 - 31 日的总和 CASE WHEN ( (#{month} = 1 AND p.YEAR = #{year} - 1 AND p.MONTH = 12) OR (p.YEAR = #{year} AND p.MONTH = #{month} - 1) ) THEN IFNULL(p.DAY_26, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_27, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_28, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_29, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_30, 0) + IFNULL(p.DAY_31, 0) ELSE 0 END AS day_26_31_sum FROM
p WHERE ( (p.YEAR = #{year} AND p.MONTH IN (#{month}, #{month} - 1)) OR (#{month} = 1 AND p.YEAR = #{year} - 1 AND p.MONTH = 12) ) AND p.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND p.IS_DELETE = 0 ) -- 主查询根据 BRAND 分组汇总数据 SELECT ppd.BRAND, COUNT(DISTINCT ppd.PRODUCT_CODE) AS skuCount, SUM(ppd.day_1_25_sum + ppd.day_26_31_sum) AS PLAN_QTY FROM preprocessed_data ppd GROUP BY ppd.BRAND ) proPlan ON proPlan.BRAND = productInfo.BRAND LEFT JOIN ( -- 硫化完成数 SELECT pro.BRAND, sum( f.DAY_FINISH_QTY ) finish_quantity FROM
f left JOIN t_mdm_product_info pro ON f.PRODUCT_CODE = pro.PRODUCT_CODE WHERE f.IS_DELETE = 0 AND (( -- 上个月 26 - 31 日的数据 f.FINISH_DATE BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', #{month} - 1, '-26'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND LAST_DAY(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', #{month} - 1, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d')) ) OR ( -- 本月 1 - 25 日的数据 f.FINISH_DATE BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', #{month}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', #{month}, '-25'), '%Y-%m-%d') )) GROUP BY pro.BRAND ) proFinish ON proFinish.BRAND = productInfo.BRAND
LEFT JOIN ( -- 期初库存 SELECT pro.BRAND, COUNT(DISTINCT proStock.PRODUCT_CODE) as stockSkuCount, sum(proStock.STOCK_QTY) as stockQty FROM
proStock LEFT JOIN T_MDM_PRODUCT_INFO pro ON proStock.PRODUCT_CODE = pro.PRODUCT_CODE WHERE proStock.IS_DELETE = 0 AND proStock.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND proStock.YEAR = #{year} - 1 AND proStock.MONTH = 12 AND proStock.YEAR = #{year} AND proStock.MONTH = #{month} - 1 GROUP BY pro.BRAND ) stock ON stock.BRAND = productInfo.BRAND
LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data dict ON dict.DICT_VALUE = proPlan.BRAND AND dict.DICT_TYPE = 'biz_brand_name'

SELECT '胎圈' as productProcessName, 'tq' as productProcess, a.schedule_date, COUNT(1) AS planSkuCount, SUM(IFNULL(a.mid_plan_qty, 0) + IFNULL(a.night_plan_qty, 0)) AS planSkuQty, SUM(IFNULL(a.night_plan_qty, 0)) AS nightPlanQty, SUM(IFNULL(floor(fq.DAY_FINISH_QTY), 0) + IFNULL(floor(fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY), 0)) as finishQty, ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(a.stock_qty, 0)), 1) AS stockQty, SUM(b.NIGHT_PLAN_QTY) AS lastDayPlanQty, SUM(IF((IFNULL(a.mid_plan_qty, 0) + IFNULL(a.night_plan_qty, 0)) / IFNULL(floor(fq.DAY_FINISH_QTY), 0) + IFNULL(floor(fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY), 0) < 0.9, 1, 0)) AS abnormalSkuCount FROM t_tq_schedule_result a LEFT JOIN t_tq_day_finish_qty fq on a.order_no = fq.order_no and fq.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN t_tq_schedule_result b ON a.schedule_date = DATE_ADD(b.schedule_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) and a.bead_code = b.bead_code and b.del_flag = '0' WHERE a.del_flag = '0' AND a.schedule_date BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate GROUP BY a.schedule_date
UNION ALL
SELECT '钢丝圈' as productProcessName, 'gsq' as productProcess, a.schedule_date, COUNT(1) AS planSkuCount, SUM(IFNULL(a.mid_plan_qty, 0) + IFNULL(a.night_plan_qty, 0)) AS planSkuQty, SUM(IFNULL(a.night_plan_qty, 0)) AS nightPlanQty, SUM(IFNULL(floor(fq.DAY_FINISH_QTY), 0) + IFNULL(floor(fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY), 0)) as finishQty, ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(a.stock_qty, 0)), 1) AS stockQty, SUM(b.NIGHT_PLAN_QTY) AS lastDayPlanQty, SUM(IF((IFNULL(a.mid_plan_qty, 0) + IFNULL(a.night_plan_qty, 0)) / IFNULL(floor(fq.DAY_FINISH_QTY), 0) + IFNULL(floor(fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY), 0) < 0.9, 1, 0)) AS abnormalSkuCount FROM t_gsq_schedule_result a LEFT JOIN t_gsq_day_finish_qty fq on a.order_no = fq.order_no and fq.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN t_gsq_schedule_result b ON a.schedule_date = DATE_ADD(b.schedule_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) and a.steel_ring_code = b.steel_ring_code and b.del_flag = '0' WHERE a.del_flag = '0' AND a.schedule_date BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate GROUP BY a.schedule_date

SELECT '钢带压延' as productProcessName, 'gdyy' as productProcess, a.schedule_date, COUNT(1) AS planSkuCount, SUM(IFNULL(a.class1_plan, 0) + IFNULL(a.class2_plan, 0)) AS planSkuQty, SUM(IFNULL(a.class2_plan, 0)) AS nightPlanQty, SUM(IFNULL(floor(fq.class1_finish_qty), 0) + IFNULL(floor(fq.class2_finish_qty), 0)) as finishQty, ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(a.stock_qty, 0)), 1) AS stockQty, SUM(b.class2_plan) AS lastDayPlanQty, SUM(IF((IFNULL(a.class1_plan, 0) + IFNULL(a.class2_plan, 0)) / IFNULL(floor(fq.class1_finish_qty), 0) + IFNULL(floor(fq.class2_finish_qty), 0) < 0.9, 1, 0)) AS abnormalSkuCount FROM t_gdyy_schedule_result a LEFT JOIN t_gdyy_day_finish_qty fq on a.order_no = fq.order_no and fq.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN t_gdyy_schedule_result b ON a.schedule_date = DATE_ADD(b.schedule_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) and a.big_roll_code = b.big_roll_code and b.del_flag = '0' WHERE a.del_flag = '0' AND a.schedule_date BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate GROUP BY a.schedule_date
UNION ALL
SELECT '纤维压延' as productProcessName, 'xwyy' as productProcess, a.schedule_date, COUNT(1) AS planSkuCount, SUM(IFNULL(a.day_plan_qty, 0) + IFNULL(a.night_plan_qty, 0)) AS planSkuQty, SUM(IFNULL(a.night_plan_qty, 0)) AS nightPlanQty, SUM(IFNULL(floor(fq.DAY_FINISH_QTY), 0) + IFNULL(floor(fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY), 0)) as finishQty, ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(stock.stock_num, 0) + IFNULL(stock.modify_num, 0) - IFNULL(stock.bad_num, 0)), 1) AS stockQty, SUM(b.NIGHT_PLAN_QTY) AS lastDayPlanQty, SUM(IF((IFNULL(a.day_plan_qty, 0) + IFNULL(a.night_plan_qty, 0)) / IFNULL(floor(fq.DAY_FINISH_QTY), 0) + IFNULL(floor(fq.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY), 0) < 0.9, 1, 0)) AS abnormalSkuCount FROM t_xwyy_schedule_result a LEFT JOIN t_xwyy_day_finish_qty fq on a.order_no = fq.order_no and fq.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN t_xwyy_stock stock ON a.big_roll_code = stock.material_code and a.schedule_date = DATE_ADD(stock.stock_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND stock.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN t_xwyy_schedule_result b ON a.schedule_date = DATE_ADD(b.schedule_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) and a.big_roll_code = b.big_roll_code and b.del_flag = '0' WHERE a.del_flag = '0' AND a.schedule_date BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate GROUP BY a.schedule_date
UNION ALL
SELECT '密炼' as productProcessName, 'ml' as productProcess, a.SCHEDULE_DATE, COUNT(1) AS planSkuCount, SUM(IFNULL(a.mid_plan_qty, 0) + IFNULL(a.night_plan_qty, 0)) AS planSkuQty, SUM(IFNULL(a.night_plan_qty, 0)) AS nightPlanQty, SUM(IFNULL(floor(tgf.MID_FINISH_QTY), 0) + IFNULL(floor(tgf.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY), 0)) as finishQty, ROUND(SUM(a.stock_qty), 1) AS stockQty, SUM(b.NIGHT_PLAN_QTY) AS lastDayPlanQty, SUM(IF((IFNULL(a.mid_plan_qty, 0) + IFNULL(a.night_plan_qty, 0)) / IFNULL(floor(tgf.MID_FINISH_QTY), 0) + IFNULL(floor(tgf.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY), 0) < 0.9, 1, 0)) AS abnormalSkuCount from t_glue_schedule_result a LEFT JOIN t_glue_schedule_result b ON a.schedule_date = DATE_ADD(b.schedule_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) and a.glue = b.glue and a.SAP_CODE = b.SAP_CODE and b.del_flag = '0' left join t_glue_finish tgf on a.order_no = tgf.order_no and tgf.del_flag = 0 WHERE a.del_flag = '0' AND a.schedule_date BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate GROUP BY a.schedule_date
ORDER BY productProcess, schedule_date

SET @startDate = #{startDate}; SET @endDate = #{endDate};
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(cxr.schedule_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS scheduleDate, IFNULL(CEILING(sum((IFNULL(cxr.CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(cxr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0)) * ci.TREAD_SHOULDER_LENGTH / 1000)), 0) treadConsumeQty, IFNULL(CEILING(sum((IFNULL(cxr.CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(cxr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0)) * ci.SIDEWALL_LENGTH / 1000)), 0) sideWallConsumeQty, IFNULL(CEILING(sum((IFNULL(cxr.CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(cxr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0)) * CI.FIT_DRUM_PERIMETER / 1000)), 0) fitConsumeQty, IFNULL(sum(IFNULL(cxr.CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(cxr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0)), 0) cxConsumeQty, IFNULL(CEILING(SUM((IFNULL(cxr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(cxr.CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY, 0)) * IFNULL(CI.FIT_DRUM_PERIMETER, 0) * (IFNULL(CI.BELT_CRAFT1, 0) + IFNULL(CI.BELT_CRAFT2, 0)) / IFNULL(RO.BREADTH, gp.param_value) / 1000 / 1000)), 0) gdyyCxConsumeQty FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ inner join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on cxr.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION LEFT JOIN T_CD15_BIG_ROLL RO ON RO.BIG_ROLL_CODE = CI.ARTICLE_CROWN_SPEC AND RO.DEL_FLAG = '0' LEFT JOIN t_gdyy_params gp ON gp.param_code = 'BREADTH' AND gp.del_flag = '0' WHERE cxr.del_flag = '0' AND cxr.schedule_date BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate GROUP BY cxr.schedule_date

SET @startDate = #{startDate}; SET @endDate = #{endDate}; SET @startDateSubOne = DATE_SUB(@startDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY); SET @endDateSubOne = DATE_SUB(@endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY);
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.schedule_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS scheduleDate, SUM(cxConsumeQty) as cxConsumeQty FROM (SELECT cxr.schedule_date, IFNULL(sum(cxr.NIGHT_PLAN_QTY), 0) as cxConsumeQty FROM T_TQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr WHERE cxr.schedule_date BETWEEN @startDate AND @endDate GROUP BY cxr.schedule_date
UNION ALL
select DATE_ADD(cxr.schedule_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), IFNULL(sum(cxr.DAY_PLAN_QTY), 0) as cxConsumeQty from T_TQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr where cxr.del_flag = '0' AND cxr.schedule_date BETWEEN @startDateSubOne AND @endDateSubOne GROUP BY cxr.schedule_date) t GROUP BY t.schedule_date
